dataSources: `sourcetype=dell:sonicwall:firewall` with `rule`, `hits` or message-derived hit counters per access rule
spl:
index=netfw sourcetype="dell:sonicwall:firewall" earliest=-30d@d
| where isnotnull(rule) AND match(lower(fw_action),"(?i)allow|accept|permit")
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(hits) as daily_hits by rule, rule_name
| eventstats sum(daily_hits) as total_hits by rule
| where total_hits=0 OR total_hits<5
| dedup rule
| table rule, rule_name, total_hits

detailedImplementation:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Dell SonicWall Add-on for Splunk (Splunkbase 6203)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=dell:sonicwall:firewall into netfw. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`rule, rule_name, total_hits`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
grandmaExplanation: Many SonicWall policies accrue over years; zero-hit rules may be candidates for removal or indicate logging gaps — we monitor SonicWall logs so teams can act before users feel pain.
